perf.summary: Mark ModPow (and the leaf Run methods) AggressiveInlining and reduce one redundant square at loop end.
perf.currentCost: ModPow is a private leaf called once per Factorial table build; not inlined. It also squares b on the final iteration even when e becomes 0 right after, wasting one modmul.
perf.proposedChange: Add [MethodImpl(AggressiveInlining)] to ModPow; restructure loop to skip the final b=b*b%mod when e>>=1 reaches 0 (test e after shift). Inlining lets Burst fold the single call site.
perf.rationale: Saves one 64-bit modmul per ModPow call and removes call overhead at the single hot site that builds invFact. Constant-factor but real.
perf.risk: Reordering must not change which bits are consumed; standard pattern is to break when e==0 after the shift. Verify last-iteration square elision keeps result identical (it does, the extra square is dead).
